summary: Frontend-only verification of webdash Broadcast enhancements round 3 (Template EDIT, Delivery Report XLSX export, Scheduled Template Blast) and new Admin System Health card at /api/dash. ALL 4 feature areas (A/B/C/D) + regression PASS end-to-end. (A) QUICK TEMPLATE EDIT: tapping builtin:holiday fills composer; bc-save-template creates a custom chip bc-tpl-<uuid> with bc-tpl-edit-<uuid> + bc-tpl-del-<uuid>; clicking edit-<uuid> loads the tpl, shows bc-cancel-edit, flips the save button to '✏️ Update template'; saving PATCHes /broadcasts/templates/{id} and shows 'Template updated ✓'; re-applying the chip loads the edited title into composer; delete via confirm() works. (B) DELIVERY REPORT EXPORT: live-sent a bc broadcast to Everyone (35 recipients), opened the row and receipts panel, bc-export-xlsx button labelled 'Download Excel' triggers a real download — filename broadcast_delivery_<id>.xlsx captured via page.expect_download. (C) SCHEDULED TEMPLATE BLAST: applied builtin:maintenance, chose bc-aud-all, clicked bc-when-schedule, filled bc-sched-at with tomorrow@10:00, primary button text correctly flipped to 'Schedule', confirm modal fires bc-confirm-send; the row shows in history with a 'Scheduled' chip tone amber (class 'chip amber'). (D) SYSTEM HEALTH card on Admin: admin-diagnostics card renders at card-position 0 (top), shows 🩺 'System health', green diag-ok banner 'All systems healthy ✓', diag-employees '👥 Employees: 431 (412 Active)', diag-scheduler '⚙️ Background jobs: running (10)', plus Departments:14 and Demo accounts:39. Regression: builtin template apply still fills composer (shift_change → Marathi 'शिफ्ट बदल सूचना'), all 7 receipt filter chips present with correct counts (All 35, Delivered 0, Opened 0, Sent 0, Failed 0, No app/push off 35, Quiet hours 0) and bc-rfilter-no_token keeps 35 rows. Role gate unchanged (previously verified).
critical_code_review_comments: Broadcast.tsx is now 665 lines — right at the 700-line soft cap after adding template-edit + schedule UI. Recommend splitting Compose/History/DetailModal into separate files before the next feature round.

The sidebar Admin NavLink (<NavLink to="/admin">) in App.tsx line 143 has NO data-testid — unlike nav-presence/nav-broadcast. Add data-testid="nav-admin" (and nav-employees) for consistency and to match the explicit testID language used elsewhere.
deleteTemplate() still uses window.confirm (blocking native dialog) instead of a styled modal; works but not consistent with bc-confirm-modal UX elsewhere.

The 'bc-rfilter-suppressed' chip label is 'Quiet hours' — testID (suppressed) and label (Quiet hours) diverge; harmless but worth aligning in docs so future testing agents don't look for a 'bc-rfilter-quiet' chip (iteration 29 docs referred to it loosely as 'quiet').

The custom template chip LABEL is derived from title_${uiLang} (title_en when UI is EN) while the composer edits title_${tLang} (defaults to Marathi, bc-tpl-lang=mr). Not a bug but counter-intuitive: editing only the Marathi title via the default composer leaves the English chip label unchanged. Consider either (a) displaying a fallback across all 3 langs or (b) switching tLang to the UI lang on open.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 real broadcasts during the live run as Demo CGM (D500): one immediate (title 'XLSX Test ...' → used to validate the Download Excel endpoint) and one scheduled (title 'SCHED...'/'Planned maintenance' at tomorrow 10:00 → used to validate the Scheduled chip). Both auto-purge via the standing demo_cleanup_sweep scheduler; no manual cleanup needed. Also created and deleted one custom template during Section A (cleanup via bc-tpl-del-<uuid> + accept confirm).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webdash dashboard at /api/dash (desktop SPA, viewport 1440x900). Login Demo CGM +919000000500 / OTP 123456. 1) Admin NavLink is NOT data-testid'd — use `nav.sidebar a[href="/api/dash/admin"]` (note the /api/dash prefix) OR find by inner text containing '⚙️ Admin'. 2) bc-title-input and bc-body-input are bound to the COMPOSER language tLang (default 'mr'), NOT the UI language — so filling the title field writes to title_mr. If a test needs to assert the English chip label, first click [data-testid=bc-lang-en] to switch tLang. 3) The 7 receipt filter chip testIDs are literal statuses: bc-rfilter-all, -delivered, -opened, -sent, -failed, -no_token, -suppressed (label 'Quiet hours', NOT 'bc-rfilter-quiet'). 4) History row Scheduled badge is CSS class 'chip amber' with text 'Scheduled'. 5) Excel download: use page.expect_download — the filename pattern is broadcast_delivery_<first8ofuuid>.xlsx; the raw endpoint is GET /api/broadcasts/<id>/receipts.xlsx (bearer auth, returns application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet). 6) Built-in template chip testIDs literally contain a colon — always escape the attribute: [data-testid="bc-tpl-builtin:maintenance"]. 7) Red topbar 'Switched OFF for real users' overlay is cosmetic and present on every screen — does not intercept any clicks in this flow.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs found. All four new webdash features (template PATCH edit, XLSX receipts export, scheduled compose+send, Admin diagnostics card) work end-to-end with correct auth gating (Demo CGM allowed), correct data shape, correct scheduling badge tone, correct download MIME + filename, and the Admin System Health card renders at the TOP of the Admin screen with 431 employees + green diag-ok + scheduler running(10).
